top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 is original, independently confirmed, mature and of very large clinical scale. Drucker and Holst carry the physiology. Knudsen's acylation for albumin binding is the documented step that turned it into long-acting drugs on which the outcome trials depend. This allocation does not depend on settling the Mojsov/Habener priority question, which the supplied record leaves open. P001 is a close second because the discovery-side citation is also defensible. Any GLP-1 award is clearly preferable to no award.
